info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to update customer relationship details efficiently by using a specified parameter. It allows for dynamic modifications of customer data, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and sales departments, who need to manage customer interactions and relationships effectively. By integrating this API, organizations can enhance their customer management processes and better respond to customer needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the customer relationship management information for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request body.

requestBody.description: Updates the customer relationship management data for the specified customer ID. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify customer information.
